name: IC — HSOP
description: Integrated circuit cluster featuring surface-mount HSOP footprints with exposed pads, thermal vias, and slug options across 8 to 54 pin variants.
selection_hints: Match the exact HSOP footprint variant, including pin count, lead pitch, and body size.
Verify thermal pad requirements such as slug orientation (SlugUp or SlugDown) and thermal via options.
Confirm surface-mount land pattern compatibility for the selected part.
avoid_when: The layout requires a through-hole or non-HSOP IC package.
The design requires a pin count, pitch, or pad layout not present in the available HSOP footprints.
Electrical specifications or verified datasheets are mandatory for selection.
